presets.title: Stash: switch tabs with Ctrl+scroll
presets.question: Which UI state follows the visible stash tab, and what does switching change in memory?
presets.setup: Open your stash on a tab you know.

steps.label: next-tab
steps.instruction: Hover the stash and Ctrl+scroll DOWN once (one tab forward).

steps.label: prev-tab
steps.instruction: Ctrl+scroll UP once (back to the previous tab).

presets.title: Stash: move an item with Ctrl+click
presets.question: Where do the visible stash tab and the inventory record an item moving between them?
presets.setup: Open your stash on a tab with items and make sure your inventory has a free slot.

steps.label: to-inventory
steps.instruction: Ctrl+left-click ONE item in the stash tab (it moves to your inventory).

steps.label: to-stash
steps.instruction: Ctrl+left-click that item in your inventory (it moves back to the stash).

presets.title: Stash: hover an item
presets.question: What records the hovered item and cursor, and are UIHoverX/UIHoverY mapped correctly? (UIHoverY read -1.39e30 on PoE1)
presets.setup: Open your stash on a tab with items; keep the mouse off the items.

steps.label: hover
steps.instruction: Move the mouse onto ONE item in the stash and keep it there.

steps.label: unhover
steps.instruction: Move the mouse off the item to an empty stash cell.
